say:1:1130619001:1.text: Once tales of the treasure were put to rest, things were quite bleak here for a while. But now business is improving more than I expected.
say:1:1130619001:1.source_cn: 宝藏传闻被打破后，有一阵子很惨淡。但现在情况在改善，说...
say:1:1130619001:1.male: Once tales of the treasure were put to rest, things were quite bleak here for a while. But now business is improving more than I expected.
say:1:1130619001:1.female: Once tales of the treasure were put to rest, things were quite bleak here for a while. But now business is improving more than I expected.

say:2:1130619002:1.text: Although the influx of bounty hunters were interested in weapons, they were mainly after cheap, quick results. Very few were willing to put up the coin for higher quality.
say:2:1130619002:1.source_cn: 之前聚集而来的赏金猎人虽然关注武器，但他们更关注眼前的...

say:2:1130619002:1.female: Although the influx of bounty hunters were interested in weapons, they were mainly after cheap, quick results. Very few were willing to put up the coin for higher quality.

say:3:1130619003:1.text: But now that the Quicksand Claws have been disbanded, hunters are out in force and more than willing to splurge on sound arms.
